description: validate_path computes is_self_issued before the anchor loop (lines 365-368). This evaluation happens even when no anchors share the last cert's issuer name. The variable is then used inside the loop only when an anchor's name matches. Suggested rewrite: move is_self_issued computation inside the loop body, evaluated lazily after the names_match filter. This removes a computation that pays in the common no-match case and makes the logic flow clearer: the self-issued SPKI guard is part of the anchor-match logic, not a pre-filter.
title: is_self_issued computed unconditionally; used only in anchor loop
